description: This file defines a feature handler for listing tags in a .NET application following CQRS pattern, using MediatR to handle requests and Entity Framework Core for data access.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Contains the Query record and QueryHandler class for listing tags from the database.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the Query request asynchronously, retrieves tags ordered by TagId, and returns them wrapped in a TagsEnvelope.
